responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_mir_transform/src/inline/cycle.rs: Computes MIR-level call relationships used by the inliner to avoid introducing query or inlining cycles. It extracts direct callee `DefId`/generic-argument pairs from a body’s call terminators, resolves instantiated callees across items and shims, and performs a recursion-limited reachability search to determine whether inlining a root instance could reach a given local target definition.
